phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F7 Phase A — Financial Derivatives Source-Coverage and Scale Screening
meaning: Financial derivatives and employee stock options under ESA 2010
purpose: Determine exact ECB QSA publication coverage for canonical RMD F7 holder-by-issuer cells and retain aggregate F7 magnitudes for later materiality assessment without assuming that missing, zero, or small aggregates imply bilateral zeros or irrelevance.

official_dimension_evidence.source: ECB Data Portal QSA financial-derivatives series for Romania

source_orientations.domestic_holder_asset: W2; reference sector=holder; counterpart sector=issuer; entry=A
source_orientations.domestic_issuer_liability: W2; reference sector=issuer; counterpart sector=holder; entry=L
source_orientations.resident_holder_to_X: W1; reference sector=holder; counterpart sector=S1; entry=A
source_orientations.X_holder_to_resident_issuer: W1; reference sector=issuer; counterpart sector=S1; entry=L

scale_screening_rule: Record published aggregate F7 stocks and annual 2025 transactions. Phase A may report whether non-zero aggregate evidence exists, but it must not classify F7 as material or immaterial without an explicit later materiality criterion and denominator.
promotion_rule: A later F7 rank/materialization gate may use a bilateral cell only if an exact F7 source orientation is available, required composite-sector source terms exist, dual orientations agree where both are published, and accounting controls support the identified cell. This phase records coverage only.
system_dynamics_conformity: Accounting-only recovery. No behavioural feedback, delay, nonlinearity or closure status may change.
